# Cádiz CF’s Jan Saltzman Called Up to the Sweden U17 National Team


by[Press](https://nomadar.com/author/press/)


| Nov 9, 2026


|[News](https://nomadar.com/category/news/) |[0 comments](https://nomadar.com/cadiz-cfs-jan-saltzman-called-up-to-the-sweden-u17-national-team/#respond)


The Cádiz CF youth academy has a new reason to celebrate. Jan Saltzman, a center back on the U19 B team, has been called up again to the Sweden U17 National Team, this time to play in the qualifying round of the European Championship in Albania, from November 8 to 18. For Nomadar and Cádiz CF, this news reflects the work done every day with the players in the youth academy.


This work is supported by the methodology of the HPT (High Performance Training) program, which Nomadar and Cádiz CF apply in the youth academy. The fact that a player trained in this environment has reached a call-up to a national team confirms the level of the daily work and the path that Nomadar and Cádiz CF want to keep building together with young players.


Jan is 16 years old and is a right-footed center back who is comfortable on both sides. He joined Cádiz CF in his second U16 season and currently plays for the U19 B team. In September, he had already made his debut with this national team, in a 4-1 win over Northern Ireland.


Being part of another call-up is a recognition of his effort and of the youth development work being done in the Cádiz CF academy.
